title: 24" Smart Microwave Drawer
sub: Stainless steel with a viewing window, Easy Wave Open
lead: Sharp's smart Microwave Drawer oven opens with a wave of the hand: wave near the sensor and the drawer glides out, or open it from the app or by asking Alexa. Behind the stainless front with its viewing window are 1.2 cubic feet, 950 watts and a full menu of sensor cooking.

features.name: Easy Wave Open
features.line: Hands full? Wave up and down near the motion sensor and the drawer glides open. The button, the app and Alexa open it too.

features.name: Works with Alexa
features.line: More than 35 voice commands, from defrosting a pound of chicken to the sensor menus. Set up through the SHARP HOME app and the Amazon Alexa app; an Echo device is not included.

features.name: Hidden glass touch controls
features.line: The glass touch panel waits in the top edge and drops down at a 45° angle when you need it.

features.name: Sensor cooking
features.line: Potatoes, rice, fish, fresh and frozen vegetables, frozen entrées: the sensor menu times them for you, along with sensor popcorn and reheat.

features.name: Flush or proud, no kit
features.line: Built-in airflow lets it sit flush with the cabinets or stand proud of them, with no trim kit or vent deflector.

also: A touch of the button or a gentle nudge closes the drawer
LED interior light and a patterned glass floor
Melt, soften and warm settings for butter, chocolate, cream cheese and more
Beverage reheat, hot water and hot cereal settings
Sharp's under-counter pedestal (SKMD24U0ES), in stainless steel or ready for a custom panel, sold separately; Sharp says it slides into a standard dishwasher opening
specs: Stainless steel, with a viewing window
Automatic: Easy Wave Open motion sensor, open/close button, the app or Alexa
Glass touch panel that drops down at 45°; LCD, white on black; blue Wi-Fi light
Baked potatoes, sweet potatoes, fish and seafood, brown rice, white rice, fresh vegetables (quick and longer), steamer bags, frozen vegetables, ground meat, frozen entrées
Beverage reheat, hot water, hot cereal
Ground meat, steaks and chops, boneless poultry, bone-in poultry, roast, casserole or soup
Butter, chocolate, ice cream, cream cheese, syrup, dessert topping
Wi-Fi; works with Alexa and the SHARP HOME app (iOS and Android)
1 year parts and labor, in-home (limited); magnetron tube, 4 more years, parts only
